Google is shutting down the Nest app on January 25, 2027.
Google Assistant leaves compatible speakers and smart displays on August 2, 2027, replaced by Gemini for Home.
Nest thermostats, cameras and doorbells keep working in the Google Home app.

threads_text: Google is pulling the plug on the Nest app in January 2027, and Google Assistant leaves speakers and smart displays in August 2027. Gemini for Home takes over, and saved Nest clips will not carry over on their own. Are you keeping your Google speakers or switching?

site_article.seo_description: Google is retiring the Nest app on January 25, 2027 and ending Google Assistant on speakers and displays on August 2, 2027. Here are the dates and what to do.
site_article.answer_summary: The Nest app stops working on January 25, 2027, and Google Assistant leaves compatible Google speakers and smart displays on August 2, 2027, when Gemini for Home replaces it. Nest thermostats, cameras and doorbells keep working through the Google Home app.

paragraphs.text: Google announced on November 20, 2026 that it will shut down the Nest app on January 25, 2027, and remove Google Assistant from compatible smart speakers and smart displays on August 2, 2027, according to 9to5Google and a post on the Google Home blog.

The Nest app will stop working on Android, iOS and the web on the January date. Its role passes to the Google Home app, which requires a Google Account. Google said devices, settings and schedules will move over automatically, 9to5Google and How-To Geek reported.

The change does not end support for Nest hardware. According to 9to5Google, no Nest thermostats, cameras, doorbells, smoke alarms or locks lose support, and no new hardware is needed. Android Central listed Nest thermostats, cameras, doorbells, Nest Protect smoke and carbon monoxide alarms and Nest x Yale locks among the devices that transfer to the Google Home app, along with their settings, schedules and camera video history.

One thing does not move on its own. Custom video clips that users saved in the Nest app do not transfer, so 9to5Google and Android Central both advised downloading them from home.nest.com with the Download All option before January 25, 2027.

Android Central also reported a later deadline for older accounts. Legacy Nest accounts must be linked to a Google Account by March 25, 2027, or the account, its data and its subscriptions risk deletion, according to the outlet.

First generation Nest Aware subscribers will be moved to a Google Home Premium plan at no extra cost. 9to5Google said the switch requires no credit card re-entry at this time, while Android Central named the destination plan as Google Home Premium Advanced.
Gemini replaces Assistant on speakers and displays

On August 2, 2027, Google Assistant will leave compatible speakers and smart displays, and Gemini for Home will take its place. In its blog post, Google described the old Assistant as relying on rigid and highly specific voice commands, as quoted by 9to5Google and How-To Geek. How-To Geek reported that Google expects the switch to take a few weeks to complete.

Users can move early. In the Google Home app, the profile icon in the top right leads to Home Settings, where a banner offers to set up Gemini for Home. On a computer, the same setup is available at home.google.com/gemini, according to the reports.

Google said the Nest app launched more than 15 years ago and that it wants to put its engineering, security and feature work into one unified experience, according to How-To Geek and 9to5Google. 9to5Google noted that the Assistant change on Android phones took place in September.

The announcement closes the last large gap in Google's move from Assistant to Gemini. Phones went first; speakers and displays are now on a fixed schedule. For Nest owners the hardware stays useful, but the experience of talking to it will change, and any household that relied on exact voice commands should test Gemini for Home before the August cutoff rather than after it.

The first hard date is January 25, 2027: anyone with saved Nest clips should download them before then, and owners of older Nest accounts should link them to a Google Account well before March 25, 2027.
